messages.subject: Re: Shiny on Mac OS X 10.9 Maverick
parts:
Hi,

Unfortunately, R 2.15.x will no longer be supported (since one of
shiny's dependencies, Rcpp, requires R 3.0.0), so everyone still using
R 2.15.x is strongly recommended to upgrade to R 3.0.x:
http://cran.rstudio.com You may also need to update all your R
packages after that.

Regards,
Yihui
